contract.purpose: 最小完整发送阶段事件模型：验证一AW常态/有限尾部逃逸能力与strong tail control的完整ACK代价。不是MIG/真实RTL，也不是独立创新证明。
contract.time: integer cycles. R acceptance in cycle t usable by W at t+1; FIFO pop slot usable by R at t+1. At most one A-source R accepted and one physical W beat each cycle. B3 source R prehistory at -3,-2,-1 charged/documented, available at0; B AW intent release is explicit external event, not candidate future hint. A descriptor/source AR/output AW intent at0. Both A/B job ACK reported on final true physical B handshake one cycle after last true W.

resources.AW_service: one AW per cycle, W not before cycle after own AW acceptance. No second W lane. All own translation permissions/addresses valid and stable; AW translation setup granted preprepared to ALL policies in h=0 strong-control case. Count original+patch AW/B but do not infer mandatory lookup misses from AW count.
resources.capacity: real A accepted-source words retained until actual true W pop; zero W no pop. One pending patch descriptor + original AW metadata in each policy equivalent descriptor budget. B preloaded payload charged3, no source reread.
resources.responses: physical B one cycle after physical LAST. A candidate original-null B absorbed, old-engine logical B only after patch final B. Exactly one user ACK per job, two physical B if escaped. Errors/remap excluded explicitly; allOKAY.

policies.long: A one physical N AW at0; never zero; B queues at release.
policies.tail_guard: A N-Q streaming prefix AW at0. Tail Q AW requested only when all remaining Q real payload are physically resident. B requested at release; if tail and B both request same cycle B wins (strong ordinary), else normal AW acceptance order. Prefix B absorbed and A only completes after tail actual B.
policies.recourse: A N AW at0. Trigger only at beginning of cycle: no held candidate true W, A actual head, current real W unavailable from start-of-cycle FIFO, remaining1..Q, B pending/oralreadyqueued, empty A FIFO sufficient for entire remaining suffix, no further same-A ID AW, once per original. Synthetic zero beats maintain original AWLEN/LAST and count, never consume payload. At old null physical LAST owner releases; receive original source R into same FIFO. Patch waits ALL remainder real data resident AND old original-null physical B received, then requests AW normally; B earlier AW keeps order. Engine true old-tail WLAST remapped to patch physical LAST; single final A user ACK after patch B.

cycle_order: Physical B due from previous LAST arrive and merge before admission decision.
Read FIFO state at start of cycle; choose conversion and snapshot remaining/offset. A held W must not change; model WREADY1 always so noheld acrosscycle.
Form A/tail/patch and B AW requests based only on start state; AW arbitration B wins samecycle; one AW acceptance then appends owner; newly accepted owner cannot W thiscycle.

Existing W head performs true or null W if available; true beat consumes one start-of-cycle payload, zero doesnot. Exactly prescribed burst physical-length beats before LAST; each LAST schedules physical B for nextcycle.
Source A first not-yet-accepted beat may R if supply_time<=t and start-of-cycle FIFO occupancy<3; append, only usable nextcycle; no banking samecycle W pop into newslot.
Advance onecycle, record all accepted AW/R/W/B and FIFO occupancy for accounting.
required_evidence: All effective A/B bytes correct, no source reread, true A=24, true B=3 ifreleased, FIFO<=3 each, queue<=8, independent physical burst length/LAST/B validation, user ACK not nullB.

Compare full A ACK/B ACK (B descriptor prehistory arrival -4, report B absoluteACK plus durationACK+4), means only where both jobs exist, makespan; AW/physicalB/zeroW/R totals; distinguish nopeer vs twojob.
No AW/setup serial h multiplier, h=0 preprepare is explicit strongest information/cost grant, not proof platform has an ATS API.
Only these 6 scenes×3 policies; no broad sweep/newRTL.
Tests must check expected symbolic ordering and specific accounting rather than implementation mirror. Full emitted event traces independently audited by separate simple replay checker.
contract.gate: 如果strong tail control并不总复现candidate完整ACK与常态AW计数，保留online capability/resource tradeoff；仅此不称performance innovation。真正paper novelty仍需closest复现差别和真实场景。
